title: Sambal Tempeh with Soy Dipping Sauce
description: Crispy fried tempeh tossed in a pounded chilli sambal with calamansi lime — served with a blended sweet soy dipping sauce.
description_ms: Tempe yang digoreng rangup kemudian dicampur dengan sambal cili yang ditumbuk dan perahan limau kasturi — dicicah dengan sambal kicap pedas.
steps: Slice 1 block of tempeh thinly; fry in hot oil until golden and crispy. Drain and set aside.
Halve the bird's eye chillies and large red chillies (to prevent them from bursting during frying); fry in hot oil with 0.5 tomato, 0.5 onion and 5 garlic cloves until wilted and lightly charred.
Pound the fried aromatics until coarsely ground.
Season with salt, sugar and seasoning powder.
Add the fried tempeh; fold it into the sambal — do not over-pound, keep some crunch.
Squeeze in juice of 5 calamansi limes for a sour-spicy finish.
[Sambal kicap] Blend sweet soy sauce, bird's eye chilli and garlic until smooth; serve alongside.
steps_ms: Potong 1 blok tempe nipis-nipis; goreng dalam minyak panas sehingga golden rangup. Toskan dan ketepikan.

Belah dua cili padi dan lada besar (elak meletus semasa goreng); goreng dalam minyak panas bersama setengah biji tomato, setengah biji bawang merah dan 5 ulas bawang putih sehingga layu dan sedikit hangus.
Tumbuk semua bahan yang dah digoreng sehingga lumat kasar.
Tambah garam, gula dan serbuk perasa.
Masukkan tempe goreng; gaul — jangan tumbuk terlalu hancur, kekalkan krup.
Perah jus 5 biji limau kasturi untuk rasa masam-pedas.
[Sambal kicap] Blend kicap manis, cili padi dan bawang putih sehingga lumat; hidang bersama tempe.
